decisions.statement: Every seat condition is staged before that condition is awaited.
A model override on the options is taken over the seat's stated worker model.
A carried name that fails to bind is logged and the spawn goes on.
The proxy is stopped at exit only where no re-exec is pending.
The last cleanup runs under a force-exit timer that is always disarmed.

definition: the arguments a Claude child is spawned with, and the teardown after the last one
